dependencies.name: n3
dependencies.role: Private strict-format RDF syntax implementation; Phase 9 enables Turtle, Phase 12 enables N-Triples, Phase 13 enables N-Quads, and Phase 14 enables TriG; broader Notation3 language ingestion remains deferred
dependencies.maintenanceStatus: Pinned production release; the 24 August 2026 upgrade qualification independently passed all 387 classified Turtle entries, all 99 N-Triples entries, all 114 N-Quads entries, and all 413 REQUIRED TriG entries. The complete 418-entry TriG inventory retains five enumerated RDF 1.2 reifier/annotation evaluation entries as EXCLUDED_WITH_REASON because N3.js 2.3.0 does not yet reproduce their pinned results; the other 12 former N3.js 2.2.0 exclusions are now REQUIRED and passing.
dependencies.networkBehavior: Parser APIs consume caller-provided input and do not resolve documents
dependencies.browserCost: The 24 August 2026 N3.js 2.3.0 Vite 8/Oxc isolated-manager measurement keeps N3.js absent from the 266,273-minified-byte / 69,481-gzip-byte initial graph and isolates it in one 190,412-minified-byte / 52,938-gzip-byte lazy RDF-syntax graph. The same-source N3.js 2.2.0 control measured 185,859 minified / 51,859 gzip bytes, so the dependency update changes only the lazy graph by +2.45% minified and +2.08% gzip, within the unchanged 20% gate. The entry-aware WebVOWL production build has a 690,542-minified-byte / 175,783-gzip-byte three-chunk initial static closure and a 191,574-minified-byte / 53,640-gzip-byte three-chunk lazy RDF-syntax closure. The adapter loads the published self-contained browser UMD entry only after exact Turtle, N-Triples, N-Quads, or TriG selection, so browser execution does not depend on Node globals; util/verify-webvowl-lazy-parser-chunks.mjs proves the N3 implementation marker is absent from the initial closure and present behind that shared dynamic boundary.
